_comment: Garmin part number (System.getDeviceSettings().partNumber) -> model name and Connect IQ product id. Only part numbers read off a real watch belong here; add one when a new watch pairs and reports a part number this file does not know. 006-B4953-00 was read by garmin/WellnessSpike on 2026-10-06; its owner identified it as the fenix 9 Pro 47 mm (not Solar), unconfirmed against the SDK's device files.
